title: Cursor 3: 35% of PRs Autonomous, 17x Error Risk
description: Cursor 3 shifts to an agent-first cloud interface. Research shows multi-agent workflows have a 17x higher error risk. 35% of Cursor's own internal PRs are merged by agents.

title: Show HN: Optio – Ticket-to-PR Orchestration
description: Orchestrates Claude Code/Codex to go from ticket to merge. Automates CI feedback loop and self-healing. Proves the 'feedback loop' is the bottleneck.

title: Microsoft/GitHub launches APM (Agent Package Manager)
description: Unified dependency manager for agent configs (skills, rules, MCP) across Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot. Focuses on 'agent supply chain' security.

title: G0: Control Layer for AI Agents
description: Static/behavioral analysis, red-teaming, and continuous monitoring for agents. Explicitly supports OpenClaw gateway hardening.
